pass_1.finding: Independently confirmed the true sci-ATAC predecessor: indexed transposase complexes barcode nuclei across 96 first-round wells, nuclei are pooled/sorted into a second 96-well plate, and indexed PCR adds the second barcode. It supplies the architecture, not Pierce CRISPR-sciATAC-specific oligo member choices.

pass_2.locations: Original Cusanovich 2015 PMC4836442 JATS title and Methods lines 41–45; original source-bundle scraper; defining Pierce 2021 JATS ref. 7 lines 304–310
pass_2.finding: Cusanovich original establishes the actual inherited two-stage sci-ATAC architecture: indexed transposase complexes barcode nuclei in the first 96 wells, then pooled nuclei are sorted to a second 96-well plate and PCR introduces a second index. CRISPR-sciATAC adds matched gRNA RT/PCR branch and its own printed oligo members; predecessor does not identify Pierce experiment-specific members.
